EmailTemplate.subject: Admission Information for Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Greetings. It is my pleasure to inform you that after careful evaluation of our applicants, we are pleased to recommend your admission to the Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies at Arizona State University. Although you should consider this notice an unofficial acceptance (to be followed by official acceptance via email from the ASU Graduate College), please accept my hearty congratulations on behalf of the Graduate Studies Admissions Committee.
As Director of the M.A. in Interdisciplinary Studies, I welcome you to our program and invite you to contact me with any questions you may have concerning your admission. Prior to the start of the semester we have scheduled a mandatory orientation meeting. I will provide information to help you as you begin the process of earning your M.A. In addition, you will be able to meet your fellow entering students and ask questions about the program.
You will find answers to many questions in the program handbook found here: https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/files/advising/documents/mais_graduate_handbook_2015-2016.pdf. If you have questions related to tuition, financial aid or housing, please view the next steps section for a number of University Offices available to assist you. If you have questions related to the program or registration, please contact the Academic Success Coordinator, Jan Lacey at ncgradadvising@asu.edu.
In the meantime, congratulations! I look forward to meeting you at our orientation and please click the following link for your next steps. https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/admission-next-steps
Please follow this link to complete a form to either accept or decline our offer of admission. https://newcollege.asu.edu/graduate/acceptance-form
STEFAN STANTCHEV, PhD Associate Professor of Mediterranean History School of Humanities, Arts & Cultural Studies Program Director, MA in Interdisciplinary Studies New College of Interdisciplinary Arts & Sciences President-elect, West Campus Senate Arizona State University 4701 W.
